title: Western Prince Whale Watching Adventures
specs: Only water jet whale watch boat in the San Juan Islands
Located in the heart of the Salish Sea, prime orca whale habitat
Awarded TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence yearly since 2009
Small groups to ensure personal interaction and quality experience
includes: Guided by experienced naturalists and captains
Use of Zodiac or Fast Raft style boat with full walk around deck
blurb: Guests join a 3-hour whale watching tour on a fast, stable Zodiac or raft-style boat with a full walk-around deck. Tours are guided by experienced naturalists and captains who provide information about whales and local wildlife. The company operates with a conservation focus, donating 5% of profits to environmental organizations.

extraNote: If no whales are seen, guests can return for a free tour until a whale encounter occurs · Friday Harbor, San Juan Island · March through October (peak whale watching season)
